action_items: None required for iteration 5 - all acceptance criteria met.

Minor UX consideration: the FilterModal 'Reset' button (testID filter-reset) does NOT clear the priceDrop chip; only the empty-state 'Reset Filter' (testID reset-filter-empty) resets everything including priceDrop. Not a functional bug (chip is outside the modal) but consider aligning the two reset flows for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 1365 lines - split into routers is still recommended.
compute_price_meta returns integer percentage via int(round(...)); documented in iter4 report - still applies.

public/catalog?price_drop=true reorders results by _drop_at DESC, but the SOLD-rank sort is applied AFTER, so a newly-price-dropped SOLD asset would sink; acceptable for the current UX where price-drop chip primarily targets available bargains.

photo-gallery.tsx uses reanimated + gesture-handler for zoom - correct approach; on web the pinch/pan can't be simulated by Playwright, but swipe (FlatList pagingEnabled) + prev/next/counter/close verified.
favorites snapshot seeding (useFavoriteUpdates.useEffect) merges snapshots when items load, avoiding false alerts on legacy favorites - correct.
Reports xlsx: /rcg/reports/assets.xlsx uses signed JWT with 10-min expiry and ships as public download link - good.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily reduced then restored harga_limit on asset 6e50e5b8-abb2-4f22-9e58-f177c59eaab2 (Rumah 2 Lantai Siap Huni, MA 2190020284): 450,000,000 -> 405,000,000 -> 450,000,000. price_history contains an extra entry (PUT always $pushes) but compute_price_meta dedupes consecutive duplicates so downstream views remain correct. No demo assets deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 additions summary. BACKEND endpoints: GET /public/catalog supports price_drop=true|false (default false). Excel report endpoints: GET /rcg/reports/assets/link (admin only) -> {url, expires_in}; GET that url -> xlsx bytes; sheets in fixed order [Ringkasan per ACR, Detail Asset, Minat Pembeli, Ringkasan Status]. FRONTEND testIDs added/used: chip-harga-turun (home), gallery-expand (detail Photo section), gallery-open-<i> (each thumbnail), gallery-counter, gallery-next, gallery-prev, gallery-close (fullscreen modal), favorites-alert-badge (heart entry when updates exist), favorites-updates (banner in /favorites), favorite-changed-<id> (BARU tag on card), favorites-seen-<id> (per-row acknowledge), favorites-mark-all (banner header). Favorites live in AsyncStorage keys bsi_favorites_v1 and bsi_favorites_snapshot_v1. In Playwright, keep same browser context between the heart action and the reload so localStorage persists.
rca_of_issue: No issues found.
